description: List every caller of a symbol (direction=callers) or everything it calls (direction=callees). ALWAYS use instead of `grep -rn "X("` for "who calls X?" — pre-indexed reverse map, sub-millisecond, no false positives from comments or strings. Use direction=callers to find dependents before a rename; direction=callees to understand what a function depends on. Do NOT use for full blast-radius analysis across multiple hops — use gp_impact instead.

path.description: Repo root with a GraphPilot index. Optional: when omitted, resolves via GRAPHPILOT_ROOT, MCP workspace roots, parent walk, or a single ~/.graphpilot index.

name: gp_callers
